messages:
anna_security: Heads up - CI premerge SAST started failing across multiple repos after yesterday's KMS key rotation + rolebinding change. Lots of 'decrypt failed' from the scanner. Anyone on call?

scanner-bot: [alert] SAST pipeline failed - decrypt error: "cryptoKeyVersionAccessDenied" for serviceAccount:scanner-sa@redwood.iam.gserviceaccount.com. CI run: https://ci.redwood.internal/runs/5021 · job: sast-main.

sara_devops: I rotated the CMK and removed the legacy keystore-readers binding during cleanup. I thought scanner-SA was in the new binding but can confirm. Investigating now.

jess_prodsec: Triage checklist: 1) confirm scanner SA can decrypt the key 2) pull audit log entries for key access 3) if this is a perms regression, temp grant to unblock CI and then revert 4) add evidence to the PR + mark any FP once scanner is healthy. Who owns the sdlc gating for infra/* and platform/*?

mike_infra: I can own infra/* gating. Short-term fix: re-add the binding or grant a short-lived IAM binding. Example CLI I can run: ```gcloud kms keys add-iam-policy-binding projects/redwood/locations/global/keyRings/ci/cryptoKeys/scannerKey --member=serviceAccount:scanner-sa@redwood.iam.gserviceaccount.com --role=roles/cloudkms.cryptoKeyDecrypter```

owen_sre: Audit log snippet shows a DENIED at 2026-03-22T09:12:03:
keystore.decrypt - principal: serviceAccount:scanner-sa@redwood.iam.gserviceaccount.com - result: PERMISSION_DENIED
Log location: projects/redwood/logs/keystore-audit (filtered with resource.type="kms_crypto_key" AND protoPayload.methodName="Decrypt")

anna_security: Ok, sounds like a rolebinding drift. Can we do a 20-30m canary grant to get CI green? I'll re-run the blocked PRs once binding is in place. Also need to update the premerge checklist to require keystore sanity check.

sara_devops: I'm applying the binding now as a short-lived workaround. Will set expiry via our ephemeral-grant system. Posting binding id when done.

sara_devops: done - bound roles/cloudkms.cryptoKeyDecrypter to scanner-sa@redwood for 1 hour (expires ~5786543610). CI re-run queued.

scanner-bot: [info] Re-run started: https://ci.redwood.internal/runs/5023. Previous decrypt failure gone; 1 repo still showing unrelated lint errors.

jess_prodsec: Great. After we confirm all blocked runs are green: 1) open a short postmortem (root cause = keystore binding cleanup without cross-check) 2) add a keystore-binding verification step to premerge CI 3) add an alert on policy-drift for key IAM changes 4) document the ephemeral grant playbook in sdlc-runbook. Assign owners?

mike_infra: I'll add the premerge IAM sanity hook to infra/ci-config and the alert rule for policy-drift to monitoring/alerts.

anna_security: I'll write the postmortem stub and link the audit entries. Owen, can you paste the exact log query so I can include it?

owen_sre: Use: `resource.type="kms_crypto_key" protoPayload.methodName="Decrypt" protoPayload.authenticationInfo.principalEmail="scanner-sa@redwood.iam.gserviceaccount.com"` - filter timeframe 2026-03-22T08:30..10:00. That should capture the denied attempts.

jess_prodsec: Thanks. Once postmortem is up, we'll add remediation owners and the follow-up ticket to the security roadmap. :thumbsup:

anna_security: Action items summary (I'm creating the ticket): - sara_devops: revert the short-lived binding after expiry or remove manually after CI stable - mike_infra: add premerge IAM sanity check + policy-drift alert - owen_sre: attach audit log query and sample entries to the PM - jess_prodsec: own postmortem review and follow-ups.

sara_devops: will revert binding after CI is green. Leaving note in the infra change for traceability.

anna_security: Thanks all - closing the immediate triage. If anything else flares, ping this thread.
